headline: Uganda’s Shs31.4tn small business credit gap puts focus on lenders
summary: Uganda's financial sector faces pressure to close a financing gap estimated at Shs31.4 trillion for micro, small and medium enterprises. Economic Mkutano calls on pension funds, banks and regulators to develop new financing approaches.
why: MSMEs employ much of Uganda's workforce, so their access to credit affects domestic growth and the lending books of local banks and pension funds.
